total_length_m.note: The cited L1 cohort was reported only as <1000 um average length. The nominal and lower bound are explicit v0 hypotheses pending calibrated image measurements.

maximum_width_m.note: L1 segment and muscle imaging used 100 x 150 um channels; whole-animal trials used 200 x 200 um channels. Channel size constrains but does not directly measure unloaded width.

height_to_width_ratio.note: Unloaded 3D cross-sectional measurements for newly hatched L1 were not found.

density_kg_m3.note: Water-rich soft-tissue prior; replace when L1 mass and volume are jointly measured.

segment_geometry_provenance.note: Anatomical identities are observed, but v0 length fractions and width profile are a digitization target rather than measured facts. They must be replaced by a preregistered L1 image cohort before a biological geometry claim.

maximum_shortening_fraction.note: Sun et al. report about 0.2 mm shortening from a 0.35 mm L3 segment (~0.57). The lower v0 nominal avoids treating that approximate maximum as a typical contraction.

scaling_assumptions.note: Assume geometric similarity and stage-invariant effective material properties: axial k1, k2 and c scale with linear size; muscle force scales with cross-sectional area; mass scales with volume. These assumptions require L1 validation.
